definitions.explanation: a quality that makes someone appealing, likeable, or endearing to others

examples.japanese: {可愛|かわい}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: To have no charm; to be unlovable.
That child is endearing and well-liked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧すぎて{可愛|かわい}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told I'm too honest and have no charm.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the negative form {可愛|かわい}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (lacking charm/unlovable). This describes someone whose personality lacks the warmth or appeal that would make others want to help or like them.
- {可愛|かわい}い focuses on appearance or behavior being cute
- {可愛|かわい}げ focuses on an inner quality that makes someone likeable or sympathetic

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{愛嬌|あいきょう}→愛嬌：07293_aikyou⟧ (charm; lovableness - similar meaning)
